tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG remains about 138bp (Aug 5 estimate). Reuters/Kpler counted nine Hormuz commodity-vessel transits on Sep 24 against an 18-vessel 10-day average, and Reuters reported Gulf of Oman ship-to-ship capacity full. No signed reopening is verified. Maintain protection at 60-70%; stress (45%): 150-180bp; tail (40%): 200-230bp if attacks resume at scale. Reduce only after confirmed reopening and sustained traffic normalisation.
instruments: Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (maintain)

tradeIdeas.title: JKM-TTF Spread - Stop Out; Europe Outbids Asia for Gulf Cargoes
tradeIdeas.rationale: TTF was 72.08 EUR/MWh on Sep 25 (Yahoo Finance, -4.03%); official JKM remains $22.00/MMBtu carried (Reuters, Jul 24), while the separate JKM-linked CFD reference was $25.82/MMBtu on Sep 25 (Trading Economics, -2.14%). The long-JKM/short-TTF thesis remains closed; a confirmed reopening could compress both markers, while renewed disruption could widen the spread.
instruments: Asia LNG spot cargo purchase via intermediary (hold off)

tradeIdeas.title: Close ASEAN Banks Long / Hold Energy Underweight - Compression Trade Invalidated
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Aug 5 estimate) and ASEAN Banks ~207.5 idx / ASEAN Energy ~116 remain estimates. Brent remains carried at $97.49 (Sep 21) because Yahoo returned $97.47 while Reuters reported a $104.32 Sep 25 settlement. Hold the energy underweight; reopen a banks long only after a verified reopening and sustained credit compression. Tail probability remains 40%.
